notes.title: May 16th Update Notes
notes.notes:
- Improved reliability of auto-save function in the Midnight World
- Added auto-save feature when switching maps in the Daytime Company

notes.title: May 8th Update Notes
notes.notes:
Added movement speed settings for the main character (Options→ Movement Speed)
Recommended for controller and Steam Deck users to adjust according to your preference

notes.title: May 4th Update Notes 2
notes.notes: - Fixed a potential softlock issue in the hostage rescue mission

notes.title: May 4th Update Notes
notes.notes:
- Optimized the interaction with cars at the company's main entrance
- Fixed layer errors in certain scenes
- Fixed interaction jittering issues with NPCs after pulling hair in the company during daytime
- Fixed a bug where switching levels after activating headphones caused character sprite errors
